last_etwap_base_supply_at_init.meaning: lastETWAPBaseSupply value seeded during market init

base_token_supply_after_first_mint.meaning: marketState.baseTokenSupply after the first large mint

no_cap_limit_threshold.meaning: the 1 << noCapLimit threshold that baseTokenSupply exceeds after the first large mint

deposits_blocked.meaning: new deposits are blocked for roughly an hour after a just-over-one-token add
deposits_blocked.checkpoint: after threshold-crossing mint, during the roughly one-hour window

assumptions: The first large mint is the scenario action that crosses the noCapLimit threshold; whether it succeeds or reverts is not stated.
The roughly one-hour block window is the reported duration of the deposit-blocking effect, not a precise bound.
The cap check compares live supply against lastETWAPBaseSupply << 1 as described in the root-cause statements.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a concrete mintAmount or exact threshold-crossing amount beyond 'just over one token', so the magnitude of the triggering add cannot be bound numerically.
The report does not state whether the first large mint itself succeeds or reverts, only that a follow-up mint reverts.

limitations: The one-hour blocking duration is qualitative ('roughly an hour') and is not encoded as a numeric time bound.
The plan formalizes only the deposits_blocked_hour impact; the revert and slow-recovery impacts are handled in separate passes.
The noCapLimit threshold is bound as a single base-token-supply-unit symbol rather than an exponent, since the report gives no concrete value.
